artboards.title: Alt 2 — phone: two-row command bar (housing chips + answer + Generate)
March pane — sections, rhythm, glyph rule
Mercenaries — pills and the cap popover

annotations.text:
Direction A chosen (2026-09-13). The march recap now follows TotalStack's readable pills: pool total in the pool colour, two-line pills (glyph, code and tier above, the count large below), coloured by tier. B and C are kept below for reference.

Owner chose Alt 2 (command bar). Phone: a two-row bar — housing chips (tap to edit inline, the last chip opens the objective) above the answer figure and Generate; tapping the figure opens the march sheet.

Owner: paddings uneven, emoji misaligned, the March pane crammed without clear separation, mercenary pills and the cap popover padded inconsistently.
These two artboards are the spacing contract at 1:1 with an 8 px grid behind: hairline-separated sections in the pane, fixed glyph boxes for every emoji, and exact paddings written beside each board. A worker applies them pixel for pixel.
